scale.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
scale.h2: text-3xl md:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight

rules: Use Poppins Bold for all headings.
Use Poppins Regular for body copy.
Headlines (h1, h2) MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) to feel premium.
Overlines/Subtitles should be uppercase, small, and widely spaced (tracking-widest).

visual_enhancers.corner_radius: rounded-2xl (16px) for major cards and images, rounded-xl (12px) for buttons and inputs.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 for the sticky header and floating navigation elements.
visual_enhancers.icons: Simple outline icons using lucide-react with 1.5px stroke width.

layouts.spacing_scale: Use generous padding: py-24 or py-32 for sections, gap-8 or gap-12 for grids.
layouts.hero: Split layout or massive central typography with an asymmetrical image composition. High use of negative space.
layouts.bento_grid: For 'Why Parents Choose Us' and 'Courses'. Mix col-span-1 and col-span-2 cards in a grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 setup.

patterns: Smooth Momentum Scrolling: Initialize Lenis at the root layout.
Kinetic Hero Reveal: Masked line-by-line text reveal on load. Wrap each text line in a span with overflow-hidden, and animate a child motion.span from y: 100% to y: 0.
Scroll Reveals: Sections should fade up and in (y: 40, opacity: 0 to y: 0, opacity: 1) using Framer Motion's whileInView.
Subtle Parallax: The hero image should have a slow vertical parallax effect mapped to scroll position.
Hover States: Buttons should scale slightly (scale: 1.02) and lift (-translate-y-1) with a soft shadow increase.

component_instructions.Header: Sticky, glassmorphism background (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md). Logo left, Nav center, 'Book Free Demo' button right.
component_instructions.Hero: Bold typographic statement. 'Building Curious Minds...' as H1. Include a clipped/rounded real photography image of students in lab. CTA buttons.
component_instructions.Trust_Bar: Deep Royal Blue background (#0F3D8C), white text. Grid of stats/icons (15+ Years, Small Batch Size, etc.).
component_instructions.Marquee: Editorial ribbon using react-fast-marquee. Text: 'Observe • Think • Experiment • Understand • Apply • Excel'. White background, Royal Blue text, or vice versa.
component_instructions.Courses_Grid: Bento box style cards with solid white background, subtle border, and soft shadow on hover.
component_instructions.Board_Assessment: Signature section. Massive Golden Yellow (#F5B400) background. High contrast dark navy text. Prominent CTA.
component_instructions.Achievements_Gallery: Horizontal scrolling or masonry layout of student photos and certificates.
component_instructions.Floating_Actions: Fixed position bottom-right for WhatsApp and bottom-left for Call Now. Z-index 50.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text on Royal Blue and Golden Yellow backgrounds meets WCAG AA standards (minimum 4.5:1).
accessibility.focus: Custom focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2) for all interactive elements.
accessibility.aria: Include aria-labels for icon-only buttons (like the floating WhatsApp/Call buttons).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop'. Create an Awwwards-level, premium frontend.
Use generous padding (2x-3x normal). Cramped designs look cheap.
DO NOT use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
NEVER use complete transparent backgrounds in headers or overlays that scroll over content.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute.
Implement micro-animations for all hover states.
Avoid the default 'Vercel' look; heavily customize Shadcn components to fit the brand.
Install required packages: framer-motion, lenis, lucide-react, react-fast-marquee, @radix-ui/react-icons.
